schema.description: International Montessori training and certification. The Montessori Association of Mexico (Asociación Montessori de México A.C. — AMMAC), founded in 1965, trains Montessori Guides online for students all over the world and coordinates diploma courses in Mexico, Latin America, the United States, Spain, Europe, Israel, and India.
schema.slogan: International Montessori certification issued by AMMAC, for students all over the world

credencial.nombre: International Montessori certification issued by AMMAC
credencial.descripcion: International professional certification for Montessori Guides issued by the Montessori Association of Mexico (Asociación Montessori de México A.C. — AMMAC), aligned with the international standards of Montessori training and developed with reference to AMI foundations.
